Content: “Is a tractor bad? Is the power that turns the long furrows wrong? If this tractor were ours, it would be good — not mine, but ours... We could love that tractor then as we have loved this land when it was ours. But this tractor does `text(two)` things — it turns the land and turns us off the land. There is little difference between this tractor and a tank. The people are driven, intimidated, hurt by both.”
